resources.string: Manage how your personal diary is protected.
Your data stays on this device
No account required. Nothing leaves the phone without your explicit action.
PIN / biometric lock is planned next and needs dedicated security design (Keystore, encrypted backup, deletion semantics). Not available yet.
Download a JSON copy of your records, including schema version. Keep the file somewhere safe — it is sensitive.
Deleting data is permanent. Export a backup first if you want to keep a copy.
This permanently removes all periods, daily records, journal entries, reminders, and preferences on this device. This cannot be undone.
